stepBody: Say we train a linear model m1 on these data. Then, we replace all of the $$1$$ values in column a with 3's and all of the $$1$$ values in column $$b$$ with 2's and train a new linear model m2. Neither m1 nor m2 have an intercept term. On the training data, the average squared loss for m1 will be $$___$$ that of m2.
